label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: Home page, product listing and PDP closed on 24–25 Sep, 24 to 25 days after their 31 Aug due date. 27 AI-server listings are in production but still disabled pending approval, and 8 NVIDIA Vera Rubin products were created and validated on UAT on 25 Sep. Account hub and returns are in testing, past their 15 Sep due date. 23 open items are past due, down from 32.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Production smoke tests pass on all 250 URLs the sitemap exposes, but more than 500 are expected, and the sitemap fix (MR-1199) has not started. Figma validation now has 48 defects, 16 fixed, 9 of them on 25 Sep. No open item is past its due date.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: 404 issues closed in 30 days, including 278 older issues closed in one clean-up on 11 Sep. Billing, payment-method and dashboard UI fixes closed on 23–25 Sep. 66 bugs are open, down from 72, and two new S2 bugs were raised on 24 Sep for failing notification APIs and missing usage data. Six items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Five delivery stories are done: the Marketing, Services Platform and Marketplace chatbots, conversational UX and the admin dashboard. Book a Meeting has been overdue since 4 Sep with no update since 2 Sep. Eight new agent stories are in To Do with no due dates.
